Subject: MAP draft + SOC 2 package delivery (Aurora Cloud)

Hi Samantha / Raj —

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the walkthrough of your platform and the items you flagged for compliance. As discussed, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and our SOC 2 package questionnaire/evidence index to help structure the security review milestone.

High-level MAP milestone (security):
- Security review kickoff: internal review + documentation handoff (owners: Aurora security, Redwood Solutions)
- SOC 2 questionnaire & evidence delivery: Redwood provides questionnaire + index, Aurora security to confirm items we need from your side
- Security review complete: sign-off from Aurora security
- Target close date (end-to-end): 2026-11-15 (this is flexible based on evidence turn-around)

Proposed due dates for the security milestone:
- Redwood delivers SOC 2 questionnaire & evidence index (attached): today (28 Sep)
- Aurora to confirm which evidence items you will provide vs. request Redwood to supply: by 07 Oct 2026
- Security review complete: by 14 Oct 2026
- Final SOC 2 package delivery from Redwood (signed index + logs/retention docs): by 21 Oct 2026

Attachments included:
- redwood_map_draft_aurora-cloud.docx (MAP draft with milestones/responsibilities)
- redwood_soc2_questionnaire.pdf (SOC 2 questionnaire, standard format)
- redwood_evidence_index.xlsx (index of evidence we can provide and what we expect from Aurora)

Next steps: Can you confirm Daniel (or your security lead) as the point person for the evidence collection and whether the proposed dates look feasible? If you'd like, Aditya (cc'd) can run a short call to walk through the evidence index and naming conventions.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132

Thanks Marissa — appreciated.

I'll review the MAP and SOC 2 questionnaire with our security team. I've looped in Daniel (security) and Raj (ops). A couple quick items from our side:
- We need clarification on which items Redwood will provide vs. which Aurora must produce (your evidence_index helps but a quick mapping would be great).
- Does Redwood provide sample logs or an export for audit purposes? We typically want to see retention policy and a sample anonymized logs export if possible.
- If there are any items that require Prod access, please note that up front so we can scope the access window.

I'll aim to get an initial response by 07 Oct. If Daniel wants a walkthrough of the evidence_index, we're happy to schedule.

Best —

Hi Samantha / Daniel —

Thanks for the quick replies. To make this concrete, here's the recommended split and timeline based on similar engagements:

What Redwood will provide (examples):
- Completed SOC 2 questionnaire responses for items in our control (PDF)
- Evidence artifacts we own: retention_policy.pdf, system_design_diagram.pdf, 30-day anonymized logs sample (where feasible)
- Index mapping showing which artifact corresponds to each question (redwood_evidence_index.xlsx)

What we expect from Aurora (examples):
- Access evidence: screenshots or support tickets showing network controls/configs
- Policies that are Aurora-specific (e.g., internal ops runbooks, incident response evidence)
- Any procured third-party evidence or attestations you rely on

Proposed milestone dates (can be adjusted):
- Aurora confirms which items you will provide vs. request Redwood for: by 07 Oct 2026
- Security review complete (Aurora sign-off): by 14 Oct 2026
- Redwood final package delivery (signed index + retained logs/retention docs): by 21 Oct 2026

If those dates look okay, we'll update the MAP doc and lock in the target close of 15 Nov 2026 for contractual close. I'm happy to join Daniel and your team on a 30-minute call to go through the evidence_index — Aditya can run the walkthrough and clarify file naming conventions.

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments:
- redwood_soc2_questionnaire.pdf
- redwood_evidence_index.xlsx

Hi Daniel / Samantha —

Quick note from the engineering side:
- Evidence filenames in the index are suggestions; the key is the mapping column in the index (Question ID -> Artifact Name). We can accept PDFs or screenshots but prefer named files with the pattern: aurora_<evidence_type>_YYYYMMDD.pdf.
- For logs: we can provide an anonymized tokenized sample if you can't share PII. If Aurora needs us to pull logs from a specific window, let us know the date range and we'll prepare a package.
- Happy to run a 30-minute evidence walk-through next week (I have availability Tue/Wed 9–11 PT).

Marissa — sounds good to keep target close 2026-11-15. I'll prepare a short checklist for the call so Daniel knows which artifacts to prioritize.

Thanks,
Aditya
